spans.s:
mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Dilatory, tedious, slow.
E.
चिर, and कारिन् who acts.

n. (-लं)
A long period.
E.
चिर long, and काल time.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Protected for a long time.
E.
चिरकास्त, and पालित nourished.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Accumulated slowly or after a long time.
E.
चिरकाल, and उपार्ज्जित gained.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Dilatory, tedious, slow.
E.
चिर long, and क्रिया business.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Long absent, a long time gone.
E.
चिर, and गत gone.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Long sought for, of rare occurrence.
E.
चिर, and चेष्टित sought.

m. (-कः)
A tree: see जीवक.
E.
चिर long, and जीवक lived.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Long-lived.
m. (-वी)
1 A name of VIṢṆ

A crow.
3 The Jivaka: see the preceding.
4 An [] epithet applied especially to eight chiefs or saints, viz. MĀRKAṆḌEYA, AŚVATTHĀMA, BĀLĪ, VYĀSA, HANUMĀN, VIBHĪṢAṆA, KṚPA, and PARAŚURĀMA.
E.
चिर for चिरम् long, and जीविन् living or lived; also चिरञ्जीविन्.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Long-lived.
m. (-वी)
1 A crow.
2 VIṢṆU.
E.
see the preceding.

f. (-ण्डी)
1 A woman married or single, who continues to reside after maturity in her father's house.
2 A young woman.
E.
चिरम् long or late, and अट to go, (from home,) affix अच्, and deriv. irr.; also चिरिण्टी.

m. (-क्तः)
A kind of gentian, (Gentiana cherayta.)
E.
चिर long, and तिक्त bitter.

m. (-क्तः)
A sort of gentian: see चिरतिक्त.

mfn. (-त्नः-त्नी-त्नं)
Old, ancient, what has been or lasted long.
E.
चिर long, and त्न aff.

ind.
For a long time.
E.
चिर, and दिवस a day.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Long rested, long abided.
E.
चिर, and निविष्ट rested.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Old, ancient, antiquated, long lasting.
E.
चिरम् long, and द्यु affix, with तुद augment.

ind.
A long time.
E.
चिर to injure, and क affix: this word, and others evidently derived from it, are now considered as particles, and have accordingly appropriate, though strained, etymologies; the derivatives however corresponding with the inflections of the singular number of nouns masculine or neuter, it may have been originally an imperfect noun of the 1st declension, thus; nom. चिरः or चिरं, acc. चिरं, 1st abl. चिरेण, dat. चिराय, 2nd abl. चिरात्, gen. चिरस्य, 3rd abl. चिरे; see these words severally.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Dwelling a long time abroad.
E.
चिर, and प्रवासिन् who is away from home.

n. (-त्रं)
An old friend.
E.
चिर, and मित्र a friend.

m. (-ही)
An ass.
E.
चिर a long time, and मिह to sprinkle or urine, affix णिनि.

m. (-णः)
A kite.
E.
चि imitative cry, and रभि to commence, affix ल्युट्.

n. (-त्रं)
A period of very many nights, a long time.
E.
चिर long, and रात्र a night.

ind.
A long time.
E.
चिररात्र as above, and अय to go, affix अण्.

(-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
Obtained after a long time, (as a son in old age.)
E.
चिर, and लब्ध gained.

m. (-ल्वः)
The name of a plant: see करज.
E.
चिर a long time, विल to divide, and व affix; also चिरिविल्व.

f. (-ता)
A cow that has borne many calves.
E.
चिर for a long time, and सूता prolific; also चिरसूतिका.

m. (-कः)
An old servant.
E.
चिर, and सेवक who serves.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Long continuing, enduring, lasting.
E.
चिर, and स्थ what is; also चिरस्थायिन्.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Of long continuance.
E.
चिर for चिर्, and स्थायिन् what stays.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Long enduring, lasting or remaining for a long time.
2 Left behind for a long time.
E.
चिर, and स्थित stayed.

ind.
A long time.
E.
चिर a long time, अस to be, affix ण्यत्: see चिरम.

f. (-का)
Hogweed, the white sort.

m. (-रात्)
A name of GARUḌA.
ind.
A long time.
E.
चिर for a long time, and अद् who eats, from अद with क्विप् affix: or चिर and आजि aff.

ind.
A long time.
E.
चिर a long time, and अय to go, affix अण्.

mfn. (-युः-युः-यु)
Long-lived.
m. (-युः)
A deity, a divinity.
E.
चिर long, and आयुस् life.

m. (-धः)
Blockade.
E.
चिर, and आरोध obstruction.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Long maintained or protected.
E.
चिर, and आश्रित supported.

r. 5th cl. (चिरिणोति)
To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.

m. (-रिः)
A parrot.
E.
चि imitative cry, and रा to utter, affix कि.

f. (-रिः)
An eye cloth, a veil covering the eyes.
E.
चिर to hurt, and कि affix; the radical vowel lengthened.

f. (-ण्ठी)
1 A woman staying in her father's house.
2 A young woman.
E.
irregularly derived from चिरि to hurt: see चिरण्टी.

m. (-ल्वः)
A tree: see चिरविल्व.
E.
चिरि a parrot, and विख to break, affix व.

n. (-रु)
The shoulder joint.
E.
चिर to hurt, affix उ.

ind.
A long time: see चिरम्.

ind.
A long time: see चिरम्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Long since abandoned or left.
E.
चिर, and उञ्झित abandoned.

f. (-टी)
A kind of cucumber, (C. utilatissimus.)

n. (-रं)
1 Cloth, clothes.
2 A rag, old and torn cloth.
3 Bark, rind.
4 A crest.
5 A kind of garland.
6

Lead.
7

A line, a stroke.
8

Writing.
9

The dress of a Bauddha priest.
f. (-री)
1 A cricket.
2 The ends or hem of a garment.
E.
चि to collect, Uṇādi affix रक्, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-साः-साः-सः)
Clothed in tatters.
E.
चीर, and वासस् vesture.

f. (-का)
A cricket.
E.
कन् added to चीरी.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Conversant, learned.
2 Split, divided.

m. (-र्णः)
1 The Nimb: see निम्ब.
2 The date tree, (Elate sylvestris.)
E.
चीर्ण divided, and पर्ण a leaf.
